page.overview:
Who is Xarah Blacwood?

Xarah Blacwood was a middle-aged female individual who served as a commander in the New Republic and was in command of the New Republic staging outpost in orbit of the planet Adelphi. She had sharp features, and had a bob of bright white hair with a metallic blue sheen. she met with Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and Lando Calrissian, who had traveled to the outpost to speak with Flight Sergeant Dina Dipurl. Blacwood told the two that she would be unable to help them and that Dipurl was unavailable, though she did not reveal why; because Dipurl had recently been killed in a pirate attack. The commander then questioned why Skywalker had traveled to Adelphi, and Calrissian informed the Blacwood that the Sith had returned and the two were attempting to stop what they had planned. Blacwood told Calrissian and Skywalker that the crew of the outpost were engaged in classified high-value missions and she would be not be able to share the details and informed Skywalker that he would need to go through the official channels. Blacwood again repeated that she would be unable to help them before she had her adjunct, Jashei Zigler, end the meeting.
